description: This file defines the FakeHeadingPermalinkExtension class, which implements ConfigurableExtensionInterface. It contributes a configuration schema for heading permalinks with a fragment prefix, and provides a registration method for environment setup.

classes.name: FakeHeadingPermalinkExtension
classes.description: A final class implementing schema configuration for heading permalinks, allowing customization of fragment prefixes.

methods.name: configureSchema
methods.description: Adds a structure schema for 'heading_permalink' with a fragment_prefix parameter that defaults to 'content'.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Method intended for environment registration, currently only includes a comment indicating no registration actions are performed.
